Name: Bedan, Son of Ulam
Summary: Son of Ulam, named among the sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:17: Son of Ulam, named among the sons of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bedan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
